spec_case: issue #720: the agent tool's result_schema names every violation, sorted by path and capped, in the repair prompt
description: The first turn's result has three violations at once -- a wrong-typed top-level property, a missing top-level property and a wrong-typed nested property -- so the repair turn fixes all three in one turn. The fake records, as plain booleans in its own fixed-up result (never the repair prompt's own text), whether each violation's own path label reached it.
